CustomField.description: The hour the nightly rollup run starts, 0 for midnight through 23 for 11 PM, in the time zone of the person who scheduled it. Blank means 2 (2:00 AM). Custom settings cannot hold a picklist, so the allowed values and their labels are declared on the Rollup_Nightly_Run_Hour setting definition and validated by the settings service. Changing it moves the scheduled nightly run.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: When the nightly run recalculates every Every night and Both total.
CustomField.label: Nightly Run Hour
